宏觀及行業環境                                       MACRO AND INDUSTRY ENVIRONMENT

2018 年 中 國 經 濟 穩 中 有 變， 危 中 有 機。              In 2018, China’s economy saw changes amid overall stability with
GDP 同 比 增 長 6.6%， 居 民 收 入 和 消 費 較             challenges mixed with opportunities. GDP increased 6.6 percent year-
快 增 長， 消 費 結 構 持 續 升 級。 中 美 貿 易               on-year, residents’ income and consumption grew relatively fast, and
戰、國際金融市場波動、大宗商品價格波                            the consumption structure was in continuous upgrade. Changes in the
動等外部環境的變化為集團帶來一定挑                             external environment, such as the China-US trade wars, fluctuations in
戰，但降費減稅等調控政策也為集團帶來                            international financial markets, and commodity price volatility posed
正面影響。                                         some challenges to the Group, but regulatory policies such as fee
                                              reductions and tax cuts also had a positive impact on the Group.

2018 年集團所在的方便麵行業回暖，同比                         In 2018, the instant noodle industry in which the Group operates
加速成長；包裝飲料行業亦增長，但同比                            recovered, with year-on-year growth accelerated. The beverage industry
增速放緩。隨著一二線城市消費升級趨勢                            also recorded growth, but at a slower year-on-year rate. With ongoing
的持續、低線城市對高性價比產品需求的                            consumption upgrading in first-and second-tier cities and an increase
增加等變化，消費需求呈現多元化趨勢並                            in demand for cost-effective products in lower-tier cities, consumer
為市場發展帶來相當的潛力。相應地，渠                            demand became diversified, creating considerable potential for the
道繼續呈現碎片化趨勢，網上零售、餐飲                            development of the market. Accordingly, channel fragmentation
市場、便利店均快速成長。上述環境變化                            continued with online retail, catering channel, convenience stores
為集團發展帶來機遇與挑戰。                                 growing rapidly. The above environmental changes have brought
                                              opportunities and challenges to the development of the Group.

      企業社會責任(CSR)組織架構與運作                                                          Organization and Operation of CSR

      2018 年， 康 師 傅 企 業 社 會 責 任 委                                                 In 2018, Master Kong CSR Management Committee (the
      員 會（以 下 簡 稱「委 員 會 」）保 持 良 好                                                 “Committee”) maintained its good operation. On the basis of
      運 作， 在 明 確 CSR 戰 略 及 發 展 方 向                                                clear CSR strategies and development directions, the Committee
      基 礎 之 上， 指 導 工 作 實 施 和 績 效 評                                                guided implementation of work and performance evaluation,
      估， 定 期 對 工 作 目 標、 報 告 披 露 以                                                 and regularly conducted reviews and decision-making on targets,
      及 相 關 重 大 事 件 進 行 審 議 與 決 策。                                                reports and disclosures, and related major events. Also, the
      同 時， 康 師 傅 逐 步 推 進「事 業 自 主 」                                                Committee gradually promoted the corporate CSR management
      的 社 會 責 任 管 理 模 式， 進 一 步 發 揮                                                mode of “business independence,” further continued to exploit
      各 事 業 產 業 優 勢， 提 升 CSR 管 理 的                                                the advantages of the industry, promoted professionalization
      專 業 化 與 落 地 性， 為 貫 徹「永 續 經                                                  and implementation in CSR management, continued its efforts
      營，回饋社會」的理念持續努力。                                                             to enforce the concept of “sustainable operation, contribution to
                                                                                  society.”

          食品安全管理                                                                                    Food Safety Management

          之 本， 把 食 品 安 全 作 為「最 重 要 的                                                                the cornerstone of corporate success and the “utmost priority”.
          事」。2018 年度，康師傅在食品安全                                                                       In 2018, the annual investment in food safety and quality control

          元 人 民 幣， 工 廠 食 安 管 理 體 系 認 證                                                              food safety management system certificate was 100%, and the
          獲得率 100%，供應商食安管理審核                                                                        supplier food safety management audit coverage rate was 100%,
          覆蓋率 100%，實現了從農田到餐桌                                                                        achieving a management mode of full traceability from farmland

風險管理及內部監控                                     RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL

本集團所建立的內部監控及風險管理程式                            The principal spirit of the internal control and risk management
的主要精神係遵循 COSO 架構五元素，分                         procedures established by the Group is in compliance with five elements
別是監控環境、風險評估、監控、資訊及                            in the COSO structure, i.e. control environment, risk assessment, control
溝通、監察評估。風險管理目標是將集團                            activities, information and communication, and monitoring. The goal
整體風險控制在可接受的水準以內，奠定                            of risk management is to keep the overall risk of the Group within
集團長遠發展的良好基礎，同時能達到管                            acceptable levels and to lay a good foundation for the Group’s long-
理架構及權限明確化以提升營運績效達成                            term development. Meanwhile, it can achieve the goal of defining
及運作效率、保障資產安全，確保財務報                            the management structure and authorization so as to enhance
告可靠性，符合國家法規要求等目標。                             the operational performance and efficiency as well as asset safety
                                              protection, which ensures the reliability of financial reports while
                                              complies with the requirements of national regulations.

在董事會監督下，本集團已建立風險管理                            Under the supervision of the Board, the Group has established an
三道防線的組織架構及職責權限，審核委                            organization structure, responsibility and authority in the construction
員會將協助董事會審查風險管理和內部監                            of three lines of defense for risk management. The Audit Committee
控 系 統 的 設 計 及 運 作 成 效。 截 至 2018 年             will assist the Board to review the design and operation effectiveness of
12 月 31 日， 本 集團 持 續 推 動 包 括 財 務、              the risk management and internal control system of the Group. As of
資訊、營運等內控自評，同時依據營運需                            31 December 2018, the Group has been carrying out self-assessment
要重新梳理核決權限並於 2018 年 11 月 28                    of internal control including finance, information and operation. At
日在集團內部公佈，此外，持續推展法規                            the same time, according to operational needs, the Group sorted out
監控等工作。根據內控查核及稽核部門之                            core restriction of authority again, announced and published it within
內部審計，未發現風險管理與內部監控上                            the Group on 28 November 2018. Besides, the Group has also been
出現重大缺失。故此，董事會與審核委員                            prompting the implementating regulations and monitoring other work.
會認為本集團的風險管理及內部監控制度                            According to the internal audit of the internal control inspection and
有效。                                           audit department, we have not identified any material deficiency in risk
                                              management and internal control. Therefore, the Board and the Audit
                                              Committee believe that the Group’s risk management and internal
                                              control system are effective.

本集團所建構的風險管理體系，以「追求                            The risk management system established by the Group sets “pursuing
永續發展，承擔社會責任」為管理目標，                            sustainable development and assuming social responsibility” as

本公司致力通過可持續的股息政策，在符                  The Company seeks to maintain a balance between meeting
合股東期望與審慎資本管理兩者之間保持                  shareholders’ expectations and prudent capital management with
平衡。本公司的股息政策旨在讓股東得以                  a sustainable dividend policy. The Company's dividend policy aims
分享本公司的利潤，同時讓本公司預留足                  to allow shareholders to participate in the Company's profit and for
夠儲備金供日後發展之用。在建議宣佈及                  the Company to retain adequate reserves for future development.
派付股息時，本公司會考慮多項因素：包                  In proposing any dividend payout, the Company would consider
括本集團的實際和預期財務業績、本集團                  various factors including the Group’s actual and expected financial
的流動資金水準及未來發展計劃、整體經                  performance, the Group's liquidity levels and future development plans,
濟及金融狀況、本集團的商業週期、可能                  general economic and financial conditions, business cycle of the Group,
對本集團業務或財務業績和狀況有影響的                  internal or external factors that may have an impact on the business or

他因素。                                considers relevant.

     香港會計準則第 40 號的修訂：投資性                 Amendments to HKAS 40: Transfer of Investment Property
     房地產轉讓

     該等修訂釐清，要轉至或轉自投資物                    The amendments clarify that, to transfer to or from, investment
     業，必需要有用途的改變。用途的改                    properties, there must be a change in use. A change in use would
     變將涉及(a)評估物業是否符合或已不                  involve (a) an assessment of whether a property meets, or has
     再符合投資性房地產的定義；(b)以支                  ceased to meet, the definition of investment property; and (b)
     持改變用途的支持證據已經發生。                     supporting evidence that a change in use has occurred.

     採納該等修訂並無對綜合財務報表產                    The adoption of the amendments does not have any significant
     生重大影響。                              impact on the consolidated financial statements.


     香港財務準則第 2 號的修訂：以股份                  Amendments to HKFRS 2: Classification and Measurement
     為基礎之付款及分類及計量                        of Share-based Payment Transactions

     該等修訂提供有關以現金結算以股份                    The amendments provide requirements on the accounting for the
     為支付基礎之交易的歸屬和非歸屬條                    effects of vesting and non-vesting conditions on the measurement
     件的計量；具有淨結算特徵的股份為                    of cash-settled share-based payments; share-based payment
     支付基礎之交易的預扣稅責任；以及                    transactions with a net settlement feature for withholding tax
     對於以股份為支付基礎之交易會的條                    obligations; and a modification to the terms and conditions of
     款和條件的修改，而該會改變該交易                    a share-based payment that changes the classification of the
     的分類從以現金結算至以權益結算。                    transaction from cash-settled to equity-settled.

     生重大影響。                              impact on the consolidated financial statements.

             時，本集團的政策乃聘用專業                                 the Group’s policy to engage an independent professional

             密切合作，建立適當的估值技                                 valuer to establish the appropriate valuation technique
             術和估值模型輸入數據。估值                                 and inputs to the model. The valuations have been arrived
             以收益資本化法得出。於估值                                 at using income capitalisation approach. In the valuation,
             中，商業物業所有可租出單位                                 the market rentals of all lettable units of the commercial

             的其他租用情況評估所得。當                                 properties in the neighbourhood. The capitalisation rate
             中所用的資本化比率乃經參考                                 adopted is made by reference to the yield rates observed by
